title: Announcing: Microsoft Fabric Item Recovery will be enabled by default for tenants without an explicit setting

content.text: Starting August 23, 2026, Microsoft Fabric will enable Item Recovery by default for tenants that have not explicitly configured the setting. Supported item types will have a 3-day recovery window by default. Admins can review or change this setting in the Fabric admin portal under Tenant settings > Item Recovery.
